verdict.rationale: Mercury Command lets users ask questions and hand off bookkeeping tasks in plain language today, which is genuine natural-language operation of part of the product, but broader agentic control (full accounting API, MCP layer for end-to-end agent operation) is explicitly described as 'soon'/future, and probes confirm no live API/OpenAPI spec exists yet. missing for 10: live API/MCP endpoint enabling full natural-language control of all Books actions, independent confirmation of Command's real-world reliability.
